verdict.rationale: cfo.ai records every change to the Model in a changelog under the user's name, and users can change assumptions themselves. That covers the 'who changed it' part of auditability. Scenarios are offered, but nothing documents that each scenario keeps its own assumption record or that scenario comparisons show which assumptions differ and who set them. missing for 10: per-scenario assumption records, an auditable scenario-comparison view, evidence that the changelog covers scenario assumptions specifically, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a finance lead, each scenario records its assumptions and who changed them, so a comparison is auditable

citations.quote: Every change to the Model, such as a formula, a Table block, or a Page edit, is recorded in the Model's changelog under the user's name and can be undone.
you can open that Model, check every number, and change the assumptions yourself.
Scenarios you ask for in one line: a hire wave, a slipped quarter, a downside growth case, several at once.
Each one prints its lineage back to the source line.
